description: Comprehensive CSS styling and UI/UX design system overhaul: custom properties, animations, glassmorphism, enhanced Header/Sidebar, new StatsCard and StatusBadge components, and portal styling improvements.
steps: Expand src/index.css with full design system (custom properties, animations, glassmorphism, scrollbar, buttons, badges, tables, modals, progress bars, sidebar styles)
Update src/components/Header.tsx with gradient background, government emblem, system active indicator, enhanced styling
Update src/App.tsx sidebar with gold accent, hover effects, school logo area, footer
Create src/components/StatsCard.tsx reusable stats card component
Create src/components/StatusBadge.tsx reusable status badge component
Update portal components to use enhanced styling
acceptance_criteria: npm run lint (tsc --noEmit) passes with no type errors
src/index.css contains full design system with custom properties, animations, glassmorphism effects
Header has gradient background, gold emblem, system active indicator
Sidebar has gold left-border accent on active tab, footer text

verification: Run npm run lint and confirm exit code 0
findings: All CSS design system enhancements implemented. npm run lint passes cleanly (tsc --noEmit). Vite production build succeeds (48KB CSS, 405KB JS gzip).
